items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Let's see, your son and Herbert Trist play alto saxophones mostly, huh?

ctx.x: Let's see, your son and Herbert Trist play alto saxophones mostly, huh? Yeah, alto saxophone. And your son's got a soprano sax there, too, huh? Yeah. Uh-huh. Played soprano. You don't see that much anymore. No. No. I think Clarence Hall's still got a soprano, but he doesn't play it. Clarence Hall. Oh, yeah. He doesn't play it much anymore.
He had a, he had a, what did he have? What do you call it, one of those big girls? He had a tenor, he played tenor, I think, Clarence.
